# 00000003905

**English.** Definition: The Frobenius power I^{[p^e]} is the ideal generated by the p^e-th powers of the generators of I, and mu denotes the minimal number of generators. Conjecture: For fixed I, the number mu(I^{[p^e]}) is a polynomial in p^e once e >= e_0, of degree equal to the ring dimension minus the height of I, and its leading coefficient depends only on the initial ideal. (polynomiality of Frobenius power generators)

**中文。** 定义：Frobenius 幂 I^{[p^e]} 指由生成元的 p^e 次幂生成的理想,μ 记最小生成元数。猜想：固定 I 时 μ(I^{[p^e]}) 在 e ≥ e_0 后为 p^e 的多项式,次数为环维数减 I 的高,首项系数只依赖首项理想。（F-幂生成元多项式性）
